Commit: 80f58e741e68f346a98b562eb06b44401c47938f

Included functions are unchanged extracts. The compatibility structs and Windows adapter are separate. This is a scrolling and adaptive pointer component port, not the full libinput API or a kernel driver. NOTICE.md lists all seventeen functions and their upstream source files.
